concepts.label: Account
concepts.description: A data structure representing an account with various attributes such as ID, status, balances, limits, dates, and identifiers.

attributes.LACC-ID: Account identifier, numeric string of length 11
attributes.LACC-CURR-BAL: Current balance, signed numeric with 10 digits and 2 decimals
attributes.LACC-CREDIT-LIMIT: Credit limit, signed numeric with 10 digits and 2 decimals
attributes.LACC-CASH-CREDIT-LIMIT: Cash credit limit, signed numeric with 10 digits and 2 decimals
attributes.LACC-OPEN-DATE: Account open date, string of length 10
attributes.LACC-EXPIRY-DATE: Account expiry date, string of length 10
attributes.LACC-REISSUE-DATE: Account reissue date, string of length 10
attributes.LACC-CURR-CYC-CREDIT: Current cycle credit, signed numeric with 10 digits and 2 decimals
attributes.LACC-CURR-CYC-DEBIT: Current cycle debit, signed numeric with 10 digits and 2 decimals
attributes.LACC-ADDR-ZIP: Account address zip code, string of length 10
attributes.LACC-GROUP-ID: Account group identifier, string of length 10

concepts.label: ACCOUNT-FILE

concepts.label: Account Record
concepts.description: A record representing an account with balance and transaction details.

concepts.label: APPL-AOK
concepts.description: A flag indicating whether the application operation was successful.

concepts.description: Flag indicating whether the application process was successful.

concepts.label: Application Result
concepts.description: Result code indicating success or failure of updating the account record.

concepts.label: Application Result Code
concepts.description: Code indicating the result of an application operation; 0 indicates success, 8 or 12 indicate different failure states.

concepts.label: APPL-RESULT
concepts.description: A numeric code representing the result of an application operation, such as opening a file.

concepts.label: BALCAT-FILE
concepts.description: Indexed file with sequential access mode, record key FD-TXN-CAT-KEY, and file status BALCATF-STATUS.

concepts.label: BCAT-CD
concepts.description: Category code field in the transaction category key, numeric with 4 digits.

concepts.label: BCAT-LACC-ID
concepts.description: Account ID field in the transaction category key, numeric with 11 digits.

concepts.label: BCAT-TYPE-CD
concepts.description: Type code field in the transaction category key, alphanumeric with 2 characters.

concepts.label: CRD-LINK-RECORD
concepts.description: Data structure representing a card cross-reference record with fields for card number, client ID, and account ID.

concepts.label: Current Date Function
concepts.description: A function that returns the current date and time, used to populate timestamp components.

concepts.label: DB2 Timestamp Format
concepts.description: A timestamp format used in DB2 databases, constructed from current date and time components with specific separators.

concepts.label: Disclosure Group Record
concepts.description: A data structure representing a disclosure group record with fields for group key, interest rate, and filler.

concepts.label: Error Message
concepts.description: Message displayed when an error occurs during account file rewriting.

concepts.label: ERROR OPENING ACCOUNT MASTER FILE
concepts.description: An error message displayed when the account master file cannot be opened.

concepts.label: FD-LACC-ID
concepts.description: Field storing the LACC ID for file operations.

concepts.label: FD-LINK-LACC-ID
concepts.description: Field storing the linked LACC ID for file operations.

concepts.label: FD-RG-LACC-GROUP-ID
synonyms: File Data Rate Group LACC Group ID
concepts.description: Field storing the rate group LACC group ID for file operations.

concepts.label: FD-RG-TXN-CAT-CD
synonyms: File Data Rate Group Transaction Category Code
concepts.description: Field storing the transaction category code for rate group file operations.

concepts.label: FD-RG-TXN-TYPE-CD
synonyms: File Data Rate Group Transaction Type Code
concepts.description: Field storing the transaction type code for rate group file operations.

concepts.label: FILE STATUS
concepts.description: A status message displayed to indicate the current file input/output status.

concepts.description: Status code representing the input/output error state, set from the transaction file close status on failure.

concepts.label: IO-STAT1
concepts.description: A variable representing the first part of the IO status code, used in conditional checks.

concepts.label: IO-STAT2
concepts.description: A variable representing the second part of the IO status code, used in data movement operations.

concepts.label: IO Status
concepts.description: Status code representing the input/output operation result.

concepts.label: IO-STATUS
concepts.description: A status code representing the input/output operation status, set from LEDGFILE-STATUS on error.

concepts.label: IO-STATUS-04

concepts.label: LINK-FILE

concepts.label: LXB002C

concepts.label: LXZ009D

concepts.description: Status code returned after attempting to read RATEGRP-FILE; '00' or '23' indicate success or special condition, others indicate failure.

concepts.label: RG-INT-RATE

concepts.description: Data structure representing a transaction category balance record with key and balance fields.

concepts.description: Key identifying the transaction category, composed of BCAT-LACC-ID, BCAT-TYPE-CD, and BCAT-CD.

concepts.label: Transaction File
concepts.description: A file used for transaction processing, which can be opened and closed with status codes indicating success or failure.

concepts.label: Transaction File Close Status
concepts.description: Status code returned after attempting to close the transaction file; '00' indicates success, other values indicate failure.

concepts.label: Transaction Record
concepts.description: A data structure representing a transaction record with various attributes such as ID, type, category, source, description, amount, merchant details, card number, and timestamps.

concepts.label: TWO-BYTES-BINARY
concepts.description: A variable representing a two-byte binary value, used in IO status processing.

concepts.label: TWO-BYTES-RIGHT
concepts.description: A variable representing the right two bytes of a value, used in IO status processing.

concepts.label: TXN-CAT-BAL
concepts.description: The balance amount for the transaction category used in interest calculation.

concepts.description: Code representing the transaction category; set to '12' in this context.

concepts.label: TXN-CRD-NUM
concepts.description: Card number associated with the transaction; set to LINK-CRD-NUM in this context.

concepts.label: TXN-DESC

concepts.description: Sequential file with sequential access mode, and file status TXNFILEX-STATUS.

concepts.label: TXN-MERCHANT-ID
concepts.description: Identifier for the merchant; set to 0 indicating no merchant in this context.

concepts.label: TXN-SOURCE

concepts.label: TXN-TYPE-CD
concepts.description: Code representing the type of transaction; set to '07' in this context.
